svg.title: Compact Interface Traffic: Canvas display requirements
svg.desc: Three fictional resizable Canvas traffic elements: UP, DOWN, UNKNOWN. Blue incoming and purple outgoing historical bars remain in every state. DOWN has a red middle line. DOWN and UNKNOWN current values are dashes. Channel name, alias, description, capacity and times are visible without tooltips.

g.text: Compact Interface Traffic — built-in Canvas design
Illustrative requirements only · Canvas extension route still to verify · each element selects its own channel
History: 00:00–12:00 · Current averages: 11:55–12:00 · Router fields hidden · No tooltips · All values fictional
